units: Cant. R. to II, 6 (ref. to Deut. XI, 22) איזהו ד׳ what is the form of intimacy? [Ab. ch. VI (Boraitha) ד׳ חברים (some ed. דקדוק) the friendship of students (the care in selection of friends).—2) glue, paste, solder.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:14">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שמא נתאכל דִּיבּוּקוֹ</he> (read: <he>שלא יתא׳ וכ׳</he>) lest its solder may be consumed (if the vessel be left without water). [<cite ref="Chullin 52a:3">Ḥull. 52ᵃ</cite>, read <he>דָּבוּק</he> if the bird is caught by means of glue, v. <cite ref="D00072"><he>דָּבַק</he></cite>.]
